topics.text: The homestay has a large yard, is well-decorated, and is close to scenic spots with convenient transportation. It is located near popular attractions.
It has a huge and clean swimming pool, a great KTV, and is newly furnished with various facilities. The yard is spacious and well-arranged.
The owners are very enthusiastic and thoughtful, always ready to respond to guests' needs. They provide welcome fruits and are friendly throughout the stay.
There are rich activities like swimming, playing ball games, singing KTV, and playing board games, which can keep people entertained without going out.
The rooms and the whole facility are very clean and tidy, with a brand-new and spotless appearance.
The breakfast is rich and diverse, with home-cooked dishes, various types of food like porridge, buns, etc., which is well-received.

comments.quote: 很滿意的一次住宿體驗，入住還準備了水果，小朋友在泳池玩的很開心，早飯非常豐盛，稀飯、茶葉蛋、玉米、小菜都是地理新鮮採摘，老闆娘自己做的粉絲肉包大受好評，離店還意外收穫了兩包筍乾作為伴手禮，同行的夥伴第一次體驗民俗也表示很滿意，莫干山風景區庾村景區距離也很近，非常推薦入住
